messages:
Priya CSM: Nexora renewal snag: procurement needs vendor code + alternate billing entity. They asked if we can route invoicing to their EU subsidiary for VAT reasons. Also want a 6mo instead of 12mo.
Amaya Procurement (Nexora): Confirming. We can issue PO if Redwood can invoice Nexora EU B.V. instead of Nexora Inc. Need vendor code NX-EU-11 and PO attached to DocuSign. Also require a VAT-zero rated invoice; can you supply VAT registration details?
Ethan AM: We usually invoice the US entity, cross-entity invoicing needs tax team sign-off. Suggest 6mo amendment with prorated pricing and 7% onboarding credit.
Carlos Finance: Cross-entity invoice okay if tax approves. Need Nexora's EU billing details in SF and a copy of their VAT registration. Also need internal intercompany note.
Zoe Legal: We can do a 6mo term amendment and accept alternate billing entity with a billing addendum. Add clause: "Customer designated billing entity: Nexora EU B.V.; Redwood to issue VAT-zero rated invoice upon receipt of customer's VAT registration number." Will require signature from customer and Redwood's head of finance.
Priya CSM: Uploading DocSend packet with vendor code and billing instructions. docsend-bot: "Nexora EU billing packet: https://docsend.example/s/nexora-eu-2199876543"
Amaya Procurement (Nexora): Uploaded PO attached to DocuSign, PO# EU-00123. Vendor code NX-EU-11 included.
Carlos Finance: Received PO and VAT reg number in SF. Marking as "PO received". Will coordinate tax approval for VAT-zero.
Ethan AM: One-time 7% credit approved by Sales for onboarding. Zoe will include credit wording as non-recurring.
Zoe Legal: Done. Amendment language added: "One-time onboarding credit of 7% applied to first invoice for the amended 6-month term; credit non-recurring. Alternate billing entity accepted as specified; customer must provide VAT registration number; Redwood to issue VAT-zero rated invoice upon verification."
Priya CSM: DocuSign envelope ID: ds-2199876543 routed to Amaya -> Zoe -> Carlos. Please don't edit.
Amaya Procurement (Nexora): Signing now.
Carlos Finance: All internal approvals in place; will issue invoice to Nexora EU B.V. Net30.
Priya CSM: Nexora signed and returned. Loop closed. :white_check_mark:
